about.label: About Me
about.p1: Full-Stack Engineer at MST specializing in reliable automation infrastructure, risk detection systems, and data-driven operations at scale. Based in Dilijan, Armenia.
about.p2: My path to engineering started with game development, moved through managing 100+ Google Ads accounts across 20+ countries, and evolved into building the automation tools myself — reducing an 8-person operations team to 1 through custom infrastructure.
about.p3: Today I work with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, building systems that emphasize auditability, fault tolerance, and real-time monitoring — integrating AI where it adds measurable value.
